data.one_liner: Embeddable QR code scanner view for Android, iOS, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a platform view widget that embeds a QR code scanner into Flutter apps using zxing on Android, AVFoundation on iOS, and jsQR on Web. It exposes a controller to handle camera features like flash and flipping, and provides a stream of scanned barcode results.
use_when: You need to maintain an existing project that already relies on this package and want to postpone migration.
You need an embedded QR scanner view for Android, iOS, or Web.
avoid_when: You are starting a new project or require new features and long-term stability (the authors recommend mobile_scanner instead).
You need advanced barcode formats other than QR codes on the web.
strengths: Provides a straightforward stream of scanned data and controller actions for flash and camera flipping.
Zero third-party iOS dependencies using native AVFoundation.
weaknesses: It is a maintenance-only fork with no new features or API extensions planned.
Android zxing native library is outdated and unmaintained with known native-level bugs.
Web support is in an early stage with limitations on preview constraints and features like flash.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding CAMERA permission in AndroidManifest.xml, NSCameraUsageDescription in iOS Info.plist, and a JS script tag in web/index.html.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Actively maintained and recommended alternative for QR and barcode scanning with modern feature support and long-term stability.
